english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for challenging someone to compete or daring them to do something.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for challenging a person, authority, opponent, or danger.
Use this when contesting someone’s authority, position, decision, or claim in a confrontational sense.

examples.english: I challenge you to race me.

examples.english: I dare to defy this obstacle.
